cha-cha-sliding-marketing.concept: Marketing Homie in the gold Cha Cha Slide outfit, crossing and sliding his boots.
cha-cha-sliding-marketing.action_expectation: Gold jacket, black outfit, long silver chain and crossed-foot cha-cha step read immediately; head, torso and jacket remain locked while only the connected boots slide.

harlem-shaking-listings.concept: Listings Homie in the original bright-pink Harlem Shake suit, counter-swinging both low fists.
harlem-shaking-listings.action_expectation: The pink suit, leaned stance and alternating fists match the original meme without a second body, scale pumping or redrawn face.

umbrella-ing-manager.concept: Manager Homie physically holding a broad clear umbrella while a highlight travels across the canopy.
umbrella-ing-manager.action_expectation: One open transparent umbrella is visibly connected from hooked handle in hand through shaft and ribs to canopy; Manager body and umbrella geometry remain fixed.

dougie-ing-content.concept: Content Homie in a reference-matched mid-Dougie chest-brush pose with one low hand sweeping at the hip.
dougie-ing-content.action_expectation: White tee, black pants, fixed chest-brush forearm and clean low-hand elbow sweep read as the Dougie; face, shirt, shoulders and legs remain locked.
